The findings reinforce that consumers are under pressure but actively adapting, reassessing spending, managing debt, and making deliberate decisions about where and how to get the financial guidance they need. The survey found that more than 1 in 3 Americans cite keeping up with the rising cost of basic necessities as their top financial priority, ranking it ahead of both savings and debt reduction.
